scope: Read-only main workbench/chrome/sidebar/composer comparison. No production edits, builds, new screenshots, or behavioral test execution. Archived settings are excluded from this slice.
authority: Pinned source defines behavior and default geometry. The supplied workbench image shows a saved, user-adjusted split/theme; it does not prove upstream defaults. Preserve restored user layout before applying defaults.
branding: AGENTS.md requires ADE branding and independently drawn icons. Match semantic placement, optical size, state, spacing and accessibility without copying Stagewise marks or proprietary Nucleo assets.
units: Source Tailwind dimensions below are logical CSS pixels at 100% UI zoom and a 16px rem. Qt device-independent geometry must scale once; screenshot physical pixels are not widget dimensions.

imagesInspected.role: User reference; includes Windows chrome/taskbar and live browser content

pixelObservations.method: Read-only sampling of existing bitmap pixels; points (100,500) sidebar and (800,500) chat, far from content.
pixelObservations.interpretation: Current light background colors are already close to this reference. Do not replace them with default neutral-token values without considering the selected theme. The larger discrepancies are composition and state behavior.

contracts.upstream: Sidebar starts at18% of root panel, min6%/max50% with CSS min176px/max672px. It can collapse to0, remembers its expanded width, persists collapse across restart, and double-clicking its resize handle resets18%. Titlebar row is40px; sidebar inner padding8px and top offset48px. Collapsed chat titlebar retains toggle/new-chat/title.
contracts.native: MainWindow.cpp:93–104,149 fixes sidebar230px and toggles230/185; no sidebar resize handle or actual collapse. applyPreferences:432 writes230*zoom, but toggle compares literal230, so non100% zoom uses inconsistent geometry. Chat has no collapsed-sidebar titlebar.
contracts.suggestion: Use a persisted outer QSplitter with explicit collapsed bool and remembered logical width. Provide toggle in stable titlebar position, hide/collapse sidebar to0, restore exact prior width. Scale minimums once and retain settings/main layout continuity.

Default content70%/chat30%, chat min20%/max80%; visible file tree is a third panel with stored size, min15%/max45%. Content is hidden when there are no visible tabs or explicitly collapsed. Layout sizes persist.
contracts.native: MainWindow.cpp:103–146 starts800/540 chat/content, hard minimum410/300px, keeps a browser tab present, and puts Files into a content tab. Round the enclosing workbench surface, not only chat. Verify minimum960px window and zoom70/100/130 without clipped controls.

contracts.upstream: New Agent is32px high; search is a command-center launcher, with a separate shortcut badge. Group by Age/Workspace is functional; age buckets Today/Yesterday/Last7days/Last30days/Older derive from activity, and pinned rows form their own section. Agent rows are32px with14px elided titles and status indicators.
contracts.native: MainWindow.cpp:96–101,174,182,201 shows36px New Agent, a literal Ctrl K inside editable placeholder, a permanently visible Today label, and34px rows in storage order. Group by Age actually chooses Active/Archived; Ctrl+K focuses a substring filter rather than command center.
contracts.suggestion: Implement honest age/workspace grouping and conditional headers, stable ordering and meaningful grouping menu. Use separate shortcut label. Treat command center, pin/reorder/status detail as feature work; do not claim a local filter is source-equivalent search.

contracts.upstream: Chat panel outer padding4px. Footer and history columns center at max768px; footer padding4px. Last assistant wrapper adds6px horizontal padding,24px left content inset and96px bottom breathing space plus status-card height. History has turn-aware scroll/last-message spacing. Empty history returns a natural-height suggestions section, so the parent justify-center centers the empty-chat suggestion/composer group; populated history fills available height.
contracts.native: MainWindow.cpp:105–107 fixes42px horizontal/32px top inset and has no centered max-width column. It becomes cramped when chat narrows and grows too wide when content is hidden. renderConversation replaces all HTML and follows within70px of bottom; this is simpler than upstream anchored history behavior. The transcript always consumes stretch, keeping an empty composer at the bottom rather than the centered empty-chat group.
contracts.suggestion: Create a width-capped centered footer/content container, reduce fixed side margins responsively, and preserve deliberate scroll position. Keep transcript-scroll changes separate from basic geometry so lifecycle behavior is not accidentally changed.

contracts.upstream: Composer is horizontal: flexible editor/selector column plus narrow right action rail. Border radius6px, padding8px, gap4px, subtle ring/shadow; dark surface differs from chat background. Editor is14px with relaxed line-height and max editable256px. Model/context/approval row wraps with8px gaps. Right rail has32px context-select/attach/send buttons; send icon16px and circular fill.
contracts.native: Composer.h forces74–220px text height; MainWindow.cpp:108–138 adds a separate attachment-button row before a single nonwrapping model/permission/stop/send row. Model max270px and long permission text can crowd the410px chat minimum. Box radius9px; send34px. Existing native render visibly clips model text and leaves excess blank composer height.
contracts.suggestion: Use QHBoxLayout for editor+32px action rail, a wrapping/width-aware selector row, compact content-driven editor height capped256px, and a capped centered footer. Preserve exact draft text/attachment behavior and Enter/Shift+Enter. Do not add a dead context-selector button before its real browser selection feature exists.

contracts.upstream: Send enablement derives from nonempty text/attachments and input state. Stop exists only while working and without a pending question. Input remains useful for queued messages during work; Enter can flush a queue, suggestion popup owns Enter, and Esc has contextual stop/dismiss behavior. Approval has Always ask/Smart/Always allow.
contracts.native: Send remains enabled on idle empty input (send() returns), disabled stop remains visible, and busyChanged disables send/model/approval/workspace. No queued-message/suggestion/Smart contract. Composer Enter always emits unless Shift. Existing bool policy persistence is correct for its implemented subset.
contracts.suggestion: First make empty-send and idle-stop visuals reflect actual state. Queue, pending-question, suggestions and Smart approval require complete behavior, not labels. Preserve explicit AgentEngine acceptance semantics so rejection cannot erase drafts.

contracts.upstream: Tabs28px high,12px labels,16px icons,6px radius; row has4px vertical padding,6px left/8px right. New browser/terminal actions28px hug end of tabs while the tab list alone scrolls; fixed pane actions stay at right. Global and agent-owned tabs are separated. Browser navigation is36px high with state-disabled Back/Forward and loading Stop replacing Reload.
contracts.native: AppStyle.cpp uses tabs8px/12px padding,2px margin,min75px; title clipped to28 characters. Many actions share one QTabWidget corner. MainWindow.cpp:472–480 has variable-height nav and always-enabled Back/Forward/Reload, no loading Stop state or global/agent tab grouping.
contracts.suggestion: Set explicit compact tab/nav metrics and elide visually while retaining full tooltip/title. Keep creation controls next to tabs, pane actions fixed, and let labels scroll. Bind navigation enablement/loading action to real browser state; owner-aware tab filtering is separate required functionality.

contracts.upstream: Geist sans and Roboto Mono match native font family choices. Main text/selectors14px, labels12px. Semantic background/foreground/surface/border/muted tokens vary together by theme; focus-visible outline2px. Default tokens use OKLCH palette; selected theme can change hue/chroma. OS titlebar geometry is counter-scaled where required.
contracts.native: AppStyle default13px and transcriptHtml13px differ from source chat14px. applyPreferences substitutes selected literal hex values and scales stylesheet pixel strings/font/sidebar only; code-set margins, minimum widths and button dimensions remain unscaled. Drawn QIcon pixmaps keep their original gray after theme changes. Old dark render shows low-contrast chrome icons.
contracts.suggestion: Centralize semantic theme/metric values, regenerate independently drawn icons with palette changes, and apply one logical zoom policy to layouts and fonts. Keep accessible focus cues. Match supplied screenshot theme as a state rather than forcing source default colors.

contracts.upstream: Reference shows compact collapsible tool groups and inline tool progress. Source renders typed user/assistant/tool/error/status/attachment structures, editable user messages, context usage, and turn file edits rather than one flattened HTML document.
contracts.native: transcriptHtml renders user tables, generic Tool result plus truncated pre blocks, plain attachment labels and transient tool-event text. This is a material interaction and visual gap, not fixed by spacing alone.
contracts.suggestion: Plan typed native turn/message widgets or a native document model with real collapsible tool rows and explicit action callbacks. Preserve original history and attachment metadata; do not represent omitted content as complete output.

recommendedNextSlice: Native responsive shell/composer metrics and truthful empty/busy controls first; sidebar collapse/grouping next; typed transcript and full command-center/queue/tab-ownership behaviors remain separate required slices. Preserve existing lifecycle tests and persisted layout/drafts.
futureValidationPlan: Side-by-side reference/native at matched client size, DPI, zoom, theme and saved split; empty/populated chat, long model/title/workspace names.
Sidebar collapse/restore/restart and settings round-trip; split resize with content hidden/visible and file tree shown.
Window960x600 and1540x940, zoom70/100/130, light/dark; no clipped model/approval controls or offscreen send/workspace actions.
Keyboard focus, Enter/Shift+Enter, empty/attachment-only send, busy/idle stop, draft rejection preservation, browser Back/Forward/loading state.
